_doc: Teammate golden set (opt-in TEAMMATE_EVAL=1). strategy: ANSWER = no dispatch (text answer or ask; also a first brainstorming reply: one question or 2-3 approaches, no request_plan yet), DIRECT = one worker, DELEGATE = 2-3 chained workers, PLAN = Orchestrate request_plan. roles = expected worker roles of the dispatched items in order (empty for ANSWER and PLAN). alt = other decisions that are also right under the teammate prompt v2.2 rules (2026-10-22): one member who can do it all is DIRECT (a developer can find, investigate or study code itself); a request that mixes kinds of work, or several members, goes to a plan; a question is answered or researched by its complexity.
